videos.caption: Keeping your toes healthy is important for overall foot care. Wash your feet daily with mild soap and dry them well, especially between the toes, to prevent moisture buildup. Trim your nails straight across to avoid ingrown toenails. Wear comfortable, breathable shoes that fit properly to prevent pressure and irritation. Moisturize your feet but avoid applying lotion between the toes to reduce the risk of fungal infections. Ever wonder why there's so much rebar inside a retaining wall? On this project, we're cutting about 25 feet into the hillside, so there's a lot of soil pushing against that wall. That's where the steel reinforcement comes in. It helps the wall handle that pressure and transfer the load down through the footing. For a wall this size, we make sure everything is properly engineered, permitted, and built according to the structural plans. The last thing you want is a retaining wall that wasn't built to handle the weight behind it. #ArrietaLandscape #RetainingWall #LandscapeConstruction #StructuralEngineering #Hardscape #Construction
